license: Original geometry generated by a committed Blender script for Korovany II; no third-party model or image. Surfaces come from the world surface layers (see scripts/world/textures).

tools.name: Blender 5.2.2 LTS
tools.role: generation, cooking, rigging and bakes (CPU Cycles)

limitations: Box-modelled architecture: straight beams and flat walls, no sagging, no carved detail; detail is in the surface layers.
Closed buildings have no interiors: doors and shutters are shut and windows are dark reveals.
Walls are one flat rubble layer: no quoins, sills or lintels proud of the face, so the silhouette is a clean box.
The slate roof is a single plane per side with no ridge tiles or moss build-up.
Surfaces are tiled 2 m layers shared by the whole kit; there is no unique wear, grime gradient or decals per building.

cook.scriptsNote: SHA-256 of each script with LF line endings, equal to its committed copy.

reorder.method: meshoptimizer reorderMesh: vertex-cache triangle order, then vertex-fetch vertex order
reorder.check: a permutation: every vertex keeps its exact attribute bytes, and the triangles are the same, with the same winding, in another order

geometryCompression.check: every view decoded again: attribute views byte-identical to the reordered data; triangle index views hold the same triangles in the same order and winding (only the first vertex may rotate)
